title: Untitled (Warplanes and Targets)
description: Large-format mixed-media collage spanning a wide horizontal field of ivory and yellow ground, populated with multiple warplane silhouettes in top-down and side views. Concentric target rings, a brown American football, compact discs, and ink-drawn gestures animate the densely layered surface with vertical red and yellow stripe accents.
composition: Wide horizontal field, dispersed warplane clusters
